Populations 32/128/256/512 have zero observed revisits; corresponding latency statistics remain null.
All eight observed revisits hit in every scheme; evictions do not demonstrate a revisit capacity benefit in this trace.
NOSA uses explicit context limit 65664 beyond the default32768; numerical resident/offload agreement does not validate long-context recommendation quality.
CUDA allocator peaks include model-transition retention and are not isolated model or activation peaks.
